children: Blockchain company Fnality has appointed former Bank of England deputy governor Jon Cunliffe as chair of its UK board, and Jochen Metzger, a former director general at Germany's central bank, to the supervisory board of its German entity, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
UK-based Fnality, which is creating a blockchain-based settlement service for central bank money, is backed by banks including Goldman Sachs
